Treatment Summary
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The
reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Over the course of eight visits, care
consisted of conservative management including soft tissue treatment, range-of-motion exercises, and a home
stretching program. Examination revealed muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, supporting the
diagnosis of cervical strain, while neurological screening and reflex testing remained within normal limits. No prior
injury to the cervical region is known to the provider or reported by the patient. Treatment followed a typical
progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and pain levels declined. Billing records reflect
one charge per scheduled service, with no duplicate or repeated billing entries. The patient was discharged to
self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptmos recur or worsen.
